title: eludite.workspace.tree output
description: The workspace's projects. `state` is `none` when nothing is open, `loading` until every part (the host's solution tree, the Cargo metadata, the folder listing) has arrived, `loaded` after, and `failed` when a part could not be read (`projects` then holds what could).

root.description: Absolute path of the open folder; for a solution opened on its own, its folder.

name.description: The project or package name, as the Workspace window shows it; the folder name for kind folder.

path.description: Absolute path of the project file (.csproj), the package's Cargo.toml, or the folder.

kind.description: csproj: an MSBuild project of the open solution. cargo: a member package of the Cargo workspace. folder: a folder with no build system Eludite knows.

target_frameworks.description: For kind csproj: the target framework monikers.

version.description: For kind cargo: the package version.

targets.description: For kind cargo: the package's Cargo targets.

kind.description: The Cargo target kind (the first of cargo metadata's `kind` list; `lib` also covers rlib, dylib, cdylib and staticlib).

path.description: Absolute path of the target's root source file.

dependencies.description: For kind cargo: the names of the package's declared dependencies (normal, dev and build).

files.description: Absolute paths of the project's files (at most 5000): a .csproj's compile and content items; a Cargo package's files under its folder; a folder's files. Build outputs (target/, bin/, obj/) and hidden folders are not listed.

error.description: Why the project did not load; `files` is then empty.

startup.description: True for a startup project (eludite.workspace.set_startup_project, one of the multiple startup projects of brief 0028 with an action other than `none`; Workspace shows each in bold).
